_comment: The render cache's processed faces (rdCache.c, 2026-11-14): rdCache_GetProcEntry hands out a ProcEntry (0x78 bytes) of the pool g_bRdCache_aProcFaces (0x008ddfc0, 1024 of them) with its vertex, texture-vertex and intensity arrays set; the drawers (rdModel3_DrawFace, rdSprite_Draw, rdPolyline_DrawFace, rdCache_InsertFace) fill it and rdCache_DrawFaceN / Z / User and the hardware path draw it. The first 0x2c bytes match the Jones engine's rdProcEntry (geometry / lighting / texture modes at 8 / 0xc / 0x10, each clamped to the renderer's limit in rdCache_DrawFaceN); after that Grim's record has the three colour intensity arrays, the material at 0x38 and its cel at 0x3c.

structs.name: ProcEntry
structs.comment: A processed face of the render cache (rdProcEntry, 0x78 bytes): the transformed, clipped and projected polygon with what the rasteriser needs to draw it.
fields: bit 1 tested by the drawers (rdCache_DrawFaceN); 1 from rdCache_InsertFace, 0 from sprites
0 none .. 3 textured, 4 (downgraded to 3 when the cel has no alpha bit); clamped to g_nRdroid_curGeometryMode
projected vertices, 3 floats each (the cache's vertex pool)
per-vertex red (the same array as pIntensities when not coloured)
the material's cel, -1 = the material's current cel
the colormap the face is drawn with (rdCache_AddProcFace: g_dwRdColormap_pIdentityMap)
1 when the face points away from the camera (rdCache_InsertFace: normal . centre > 0)
screen bounds (rdCache_AddProcFace): the smallest x of the vertices, rounded
the smallest z of the vertices
index of the vertex with the smallest y
index of the vertex with the largest y
g_dwRdroid_curProcFaceUserData when the face was added
